faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Questions about deployment, licensing, and review workflows

items.question: Where is contract data processed?
items.answer: KR8V is designed for self-hosted and local deployment. In standard deployments, contracts remain within customer-controlled infrastructure.

items.question: Does KR8V require external AI APIs?
items.answer: No. KR8V is designed to support local AI inference without requiring mandatory external AI services.

items.question: How should teams use KR8V?
items.answer: KR8V is designed for AI-assisted first-pass NDA review, clause analysis, workflow management, and structured internal review support.

items.question: Can KR8V replace legal counsel?
items.answer: No. KR8V is designed as review-support software to help teams identify potentially important clauses and accelerate review workflows.

items.question: What contract types are supported?
items.answer: KR8V is currently optimized for NDAs and confidentiality agreements.

items.question: Do you support other contract types?
items.answer: Currently focused on NDAs; roadmap for broader contracts. visit our vision page for more details.
